international.title: ‘Remarkable luck’: wreck of first Australian-built warship discovered exactly 128 years after sinking
international.summary: HMCS Spitfire commissioned by colonial government to protect against Russian warships based at Vladivostok during Crimean war The wreck of Australia’s first locally-built warship has been discovered 128 years after sinking off the coast of far north Queensland. Marine archaeologists found the remains of Ex HMCS Spitfire on 21 August, the anniversary of its sinking in 1898. Continue reading...
